notes: Fixes device makers, which weren't being looked up at all: the list Network Scanner downloaded has moved, so it now uses the IEEE registry as published by the Nmap project. Devices now show makers like Apple, Amazon, Nintendo, TP-Link and Synology, and quiet devices get names like "Nintendo device" and "Amazon device". Also: your Mac's other network connections show as This Mac; iPhones no longer get a garbled name; NAS boxes no longer show "Xserve" as their model; placeholder names like "SpotifyConnect" are ignored; better types for soundbars, NAS boxes, mesh Wi-Fi points and Android devices; and hostnames are asked for over multicast too, which iPhones and iPads answer more often.
